summary: Jane Field called HomeNet because she was upset with an earlier agent who blamed her for a problem on their line. The agent acknowledged her frustration but stated they couldn’t speak to her about it as it involved another call. After reviewing the issue, the agent scheduled a technician visit and noted the complaint in the account ticket.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent acknowledged the customer’s name promptly and used the correct greeting.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent used Jane Field's name correctly during the call.

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent responded to the client’s frustration with understanding, stating “I can’t speak for that specific call.”

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a respectful tone throughout the conversation. [RoBERTa flagged 2 harsh agent line(s)]

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: – The agent restated the customer's issue in their own words ("my connection still drops").

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent confirmed Jane Field’s name and account details.

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: – The agent asked, “Can I confirm your name so I attach it to the right account?”

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: The agent stated they would log a formal note about the interaction.

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: – The agent offered to run a line check.

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: – The agent took responsibility for resolving the issue.

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: – The agent listened attentively and validated the customer’s feelings.

ratings.name: Confirmed Resolution
ratings.reason: The agent confirmed that the connection was resolved.
